answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The delta is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the whisper. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pigment of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
